name: 3D体素模型（Q版）

nodes.title: 输入 · 完整角色参考

generation.prompt: Create ONE single full-body CHIBI VOXEL STYLE 3D CHARACTER reference derived from the supplied exact character identity. TARARA: long golden blonde block hair with stepped square locks down her back, blue square eyes, teal triangular hair clips, large dark navy hair bow, white and teal short tunic-skirt over navy shorts, white puffy sleeves represented by stepped cuboids, white thigh stockings, white-gold ankle boots and a small gold star pendant. No cat. Big head and short body, roughly head one-third total height, cute proportions but recognizable adult heroine identity. Strict visible hard axis-aligned block construction: the head is a CUBOID, hair is made from discrete rectangular blocks, torso/arms/legs are cuboids, boots are blocky cuboids with square soles, eyes and facial marks are clean square pixels. All outer surfaces are flat planar squares with hard ninety-degree edges and deliberate stair-step silhouettes. Think carefully crafted low-resolution Minecraft-like voxel sculpture, not smooth rounded chibi, not Lego studs, not polygonal triangulated smooth mesh. No soft curved balloon face, no skin smoothing, no rounded bevels, no glossy toy material. Matte color blocks with crisp edges. View almost front with slight three-quarter angle showing block depth, arms held apart in a gentle A-pose, both hands and legs separated and unobstructed. Entire character including hair, head, accessories and both feet fully inside square frame with broad white studio margin. Neutral soft illumination only so blocks are legible, plain very light gray background with no scenery, no text, no base pedestal, no shadows that hide boots. One character only, no turnaround sheet. 2K square.
